cli_protocol: 17 alternating matched fresh CLI pairs for each germ, case/order alternates; one warmup pair per germ excluded; complete stdout transfer includes both zetas and pretty JSON. Measured with native mode and SymPy imports blocked. Semantic validation and hashing after each process exit, outside measured wall time. Retains every measured pair; ratios and savings paired. Interval is exact order-statistic interval for population median of independent pairs; shared host introduces serial dependence.
baseline: Both before and after use identical native libraries and identical native monomial_support_masks orchestration in _owned_supports. All source differences are the chart-equation producer and torus-boundary verifier. The original historical geometry matches both.
cli_trial_units: Wall and process CPU in seconds, output length in bytes, sibling occupancy as a fraction.

conditional_low_contention.method: Both members of an alternating pair on the same CPU must have sibling busy fraction <0.25 and process CPU/wall >=0.90.

phase_profile.method: Fifteen alternating fresh-process pairs per germ with identical native libraries and the same default support-mask builder on both sides, discarding a warm-up pair. Pinned to CPU 10, with end-to-end CLI trials on a separate physical core. Each timing probe wraps an existing operation or marks the orchestration boundary. All returned mathematical records verified independently by canonical SHA256. Fresh CLI and process creation wall times include scheduler delays. Process/thread CPU measurements exclude child CPU. Cell values in ms are medians. Totals include and residual values exclude nested probes. CPU for producer formatting includes assembling and transmitting the canonical coefficient packet; the canonical original input equation is reported separately in the combined path.

checked: All output fields outside top-level elapsed_ms/execution and two chart_batch telemetry milliseconds compared. Saved chart maps independently reproduced full labelled complexes, stratum and divisor data and both zetas; comparison list digest covers [charts,atlas,dual_complex,monodromy_zeta,topological_zeta].

isolated_comparison_exception_reruns.wide_quotient: Same unavailable Gröbner operation in the baseline and candidate check suites; the native suite passes this chart.
